The '''Peg Shar system''' was located in the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]],<ref name="KashyyykRegion" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Lesser Lantillian Route/Legends|Lesser Lantillian Route]] linked it to [[Pusat Station]] and the [[Saari Ha system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was occupied by the [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] [[Peg Shar I/Legends|Peg Shar I]], which was [[Unidentified senator (Peg Shar I)/Legends|represented]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="CL" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="32 BBY">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] establishes that Peg Shar I was [[Unidentified senator (Peg Shar I)/Legends|represented]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the events of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Peg Shar system was the site of an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]-operated Class II [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] whose output was limited to [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Peg Shar system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-8.<ref name="TEA" />
